{{Quote|Kabal! Great little outworld! Loaded with terrific spots for celebrating our safe arrival&hellip;|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="The Serpent Masters">"[[The Serpent Masters]]"</ref>}}
'''Kabal''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]], on the [[Sharlissian Trade Corridor]].

==History==
Kabal suffered [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] shortage riots following the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] abandonment of the Trade Corridor supposedly in protest of heavy [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] taxation, but actually a calculated move to encourage the planet to secede from the Republic. [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] then sent [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] ships to the planet to air-drop food, thus making himself seem a hero. A riot ensued, killing four [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as well as [[Premiere (Kabal)|Premiere]] [[Jan Dovu]]. The grateful (if duped) populace seceded shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="hnn1">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|regional/1337_3.html|Riots Rock Kabal}}</ref><ref name="hnn2">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|regional/13411_2.html|Kabal Riots Quelled by Separatists; 4 Jedi Among the Dead}}</ref> Kabal went onto be a [[Battle of Kabal (Clone Wars)|battleground]] during the war, with Republic walkers seeing deployment on Kabal.<ref name="69Insider">{{InsiderCite|69|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:9:01}}</ref>

[[File:Attackonkabal.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]] raiding [[Shoribus]]]]

The planet remained neutral during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and hosted the [[Conference of Uncommitted Worlds]] just after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], which resulted in an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Raid on Kabal|assault]] on [[Shoribus]] (sparing the rest of the planet). [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] attended the conference, meeting with [[Silver Fyre/Legends|Silver Fyre]] there before becoming trapped by the bombardment. She rendezvoused with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], but both had to be rescued by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. The Imperial attack did little to change the planet's neutrality.

The quiet coastal fishing town of [[Palisade]], on the planet's largest equatorial island (half a hemisphere away from Shoribus), was the location of the estate of eccentric [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]] business magnate [[Tyro Viveca]], and where he liked to engage in his passion for hunting. One of its few public attractions was a bazaar. Palisade's sudden cloudbursts often surprised visitors, betraying their presence to the natives, who seldom reacted to the unexpected storms. Most of the locals survived off native [[saltfish]]. Viveca's estate was terraformed to include grasslands, stagnant peat bog swamps home to furry gray [[water-spider]]s, rocky scrublands with arthropod borers, and hilly, [[stranglethorn]] patches, [[bambooi]] jungle thickets, and deciduous [[arboray tree]] forests where [[cordgrass]] grew. Viveca died in an explosion a year after the bombing of Shoribus, an event investigated by order of Palisade's mayor.<ref name="Fair Prey">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>
